en.headline: Vehicles collide in Eastern Harbour Crossing overnight
en.dek: Police are investigating a crash in the Hong Kong-bound tube during single-tube running; injury accounts differ.
body: Police received a report at about 2:19 a.m. on Saturday of a collision in the Hong Kong Island-bound tube of the Eastern Harbour Crossing, while the tunnel was operating single-tube, two-way traffic.

Accounts of the crash differ. HK01 reported that two taxis and a goods van collided, and that five people — a taxi driver, three taxi passengers and the van driver — were taken to Eastern Hospital. Headline Daily reported a taxi and a goods van, and said five people were slightly injured, with four taken to hospital and one leaving on their own. Another report said no one needed hospital treatment. Police said they were investigating and had not ruled out a vehicle crossing the temporary lane divider.
Traffic in both directions was briefly held up. Tunnel staff cleared the damaged vehicles and the road later reopened. Police are still investigating the cause.

zh.headline: 東隧單管雙程行車期間多車相撞
zh.dek: 警方正調查周六凌晨往港島管道車禍，各報道對傷者人數說法不一。
body: 警方周六凌晨約2時19分接報，東區海底隧道往港島方向管道發生碰撞。事發時隧道正實施單管雙程行車。
各報道對涉事車輛及傷勢說法不一。《香港01》稱兩輛的士與一輛客貨車相撞，的士司機、三名的士乘客及客貨車司機共五人送往東區醫院。《頭條日報》則稱一輛的士與一輛客貨車相撞，五人輕傷，其中四人送院、一人自行離開。另有報道稱無人需要送院。警方表示正調查，不排除有車輛越過臨時分隔行車線。
往來港九方向交通一度受阻。隧道人員清理路面並移走肇事車輛後，交通其後恢復。警方仍在調查原因。
